M-PORTABLE-EXPORT.Summary: Explicit on-demand export of generated portal pages into portal/published, with file links, bundled search, embedded fonts and portable interactions. The aicc.html entry point works without an HTTP server; export does not build or deploy the website.

M-PORTAL-SOURCE.Summary: Editable bilingual AICC portal source: language-specific charter and explanatory Markdown, shared UI messages and authored chrome, source selection, and the complete-site build/check tools. The build also composes the independent neighbouring sections without importing their content into the charter corpus.

M-PORTAL-NEIGHBOURS.Summary: Common O!Bank presentation and navigation for AICC, Discovery Catalog, Portfolio, Projects and AI Lab. Discovery projects retained bilingual Financial Services content into shared context, grouped navigation and expandable scenario cards; workflow previews link to source stages. AI Lab projects the complete html-alt/cloudlab/index.html operating model with a source-keyed, freshness-checked Russian edition, a six-stage/five-lane matrix with accessible focus/reset controls, both operating systems, capabilities, intent loop and illustrative guardrail scorecard. Shared portal/tools/kanban.py helpers and kanban.css/js present compact native record cards, consistent equal-width column headers and one selected inline summary below the active view. Selection, replacement, keyboard activation, dismissal and hidden-selection clearing are identical for Portfolio and Program delivery; no operational state is stored in the browser. Secondary record content uses disclosures, with decision limitations visible. Portfolio projects the maintained Registry into a dated role-safe board, review queue, Standing Initiatives, roadmap, register, gate guidance and eleven record-derived progress summaries. Backlog, Briefs, board, Dashboard and source-language agreement are checked before publication; shared capacity, Waiting context, ordinary/standing separation and unknown observations retain their charter meaning. The Registry owns state and evidence; browser controls only filter and reveal views. Projects projects the maintained Program Backlog through portal/tools/delivery.py into a five-column, three-service-class Program Kanban, Portfolio intake relationships and complete native project documents. Registry-derived states, parent admission, Waiting context, board placement, counts and shared limits are validated; the current Program Backlog is empty. INI-013 records the existing service-resolution proposal in the Portfolio Funnel, without a business-case approval or delivery admission. A stable project mapping connects its goal and progress summary to its working documents. Delivery projects the complete retained bilingual service-resolution workbook into an overview and eleven child documents, retaining all text, tables, code, diagram labels and geometry, intra-project destinations and section search. Scoped native diagram controls support expansion, pan, zoom, fit, actual size and focus return. Section content ownership, search and lifecycle remain separate; explicit Registry-derived Initiative/project relationships connect Portfolio and Projects in addition to the common shell.

M-PORTAL-PROJECTION.Summary: One generated static site under html/aicc with English and Russian routes and shared assets for five independent sections. AICC retains its existing routes; Discovery, the live Portfolio, Projects and AI Lab use discovery/, initiatives/, projects/ and lab/ within each language. Portfolio initiative summaries live beneath initiatives/ini-*/ with matching language routes and section-local search. Projects exposes the Program Backlog and linked Initiative intake at projects/; delivery-item summaries are beneath projects/items/ when maintained records exist. Delivery project documents live beneath projects/service-resolution/ with matching child routes in both languages. English is the default route. AICC source translations are selected per language; missing translations are visibly English. Never edited by hand.

M-AICC-DEPLOY.Summary: Rust command-line tool that checks the generated site, mirrors html/aicc into the clean deploy repository, writes a hashed manifest, and with an explicit flag commits, pushes origin then websvc, and verifies the served manifest. Dry run by default.

M-PORTAL-LOCALIZATION.Summary: Language source identity and comparison, reviewed translation selection, source freshness, stable structure, record identity checks, and paired table extraction for generated views. English lookup paths do not establish language precedence.
